title: Holistic cost decider with traffic slices and auto-rollback
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Goal: build an automated decision service that recommends batching + caching configuration deltas per traffic slice (cohort-aware) and applies changes through a safe staged pipeline with automatic rollback triggered by SLO degradations or anomaly detectors. This ticket covers the orchestration layer, the traffic-slicing policy, SLO-aware limiter integration, and the rollback playbook. We want an end-to-end flow: analyze traffic histograms -> propose candidate config deltas that improve token cost by >=10% for the cohort while respecting latency p95 and qps SLOs -> stage apply to a small cohort -> monitor anomalies and metrics -> auto-revert if thresholds breached. The service must be auditable (config diffs, reason for suggestions, metric snapshots) and integrate with Console dashboards and existing rollout primitives.
acceptance_criteria: Decision service exposes an API that returns ranked config suggestions (batch_size, prefetch_window, KV_cache_ttl, batching_mode) for a named traffic slice within 30s per request
Suggested config deltas include expected cost savings estimate and projected p95 latency delta (90th percentile confidence band)
Staged apply workflow: can apply suggestion to user-specified cohorts (1%, 5%, 25%, 100%) with automated metric gating
Anomaly detector runs during staged apply and will trigger automatic rollback when: (a) p95 latency increases >15% absolute or (b) error-rate spikes >0.5% over baseline for 2 consecutive minutes
All applies and rollbacks are recorded with reason, responsible actor (system/CLI/Console), and link to config diff in audit log
Unit and integration tests for the decision logic and the gating/rollback hooks with synthetic workloads
Integration tests validate routing respects SLO-aware limiters (requests are routed to a fallback variant when cohort latency approaches SLO threshold)
implementation_plan: 1) Traffic slicing: implement 'cohort signature' extractor (by route, authenticated vs anon, avg seq len, recent qps) and store 7-day histograms
2) Candidate generator: cost-model that simulates batching/caching effects given histogram and hardware profile; outputs ranked deltas with confidence bands
3) Safety gates: integrate existing limiter service to compute per-cohort headroom and build SLO-aware routing rules (fallback variants, reduced batch windows)
4) Staged apply: extend rollout engine to accept config diffs from decision service and apply to cohorts with metric hooks
5) Anomaly detector: build short-window detectors (p95, error-rate, tail CPU) with hysteresis and cooldown to avoid flapping
6) Auto-rollback: implement rollback executor that reverses config diffs and creates incident notes automatically; wire to oncall notification and Console
7) Observability: add per-suggestion dashboards (expected vs actual savings), audit logs (who/when/why), and a replay tool for offline validation
8) Docs & runbook: publish Confluence doc, developer guide for extending the cost model, and an oncall playbook for manual interventions
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal canary on non-prod account with 2 synthetic workloads (low-latency chat, high-throughput embeddings). Validate detection and rollback behavior (1 week)
Beta: apply to 1% cohorts for a subset of Hosted customers (opt-in) with close monitoring and daily syncs (2 weeks)
General availability: full customer opt-in with migration guide and ability to opt-out; GA gated on 99.9% rollback detection stability and <2% false rollback rate observed in Beta
Emergency rollback: manual kill switch in Console and CLI that reverts all staged decisions across clusters
Post-GA: enable periodic suggestion runs (daily) with audit reminders and retention of top-5 historical suggestions
monitoring_and_alerting: Primary metrics: cohort_p95_latency_ms, cohort_error_rate, cohort_qps, cohort_token_cost_per_minute
Gate thresholds: auto-rollback if cohort_p95 > baseline_p95 * 1.15 OR cohort_error_rate > baseline_error + 0.5% for 2m
Anomaly scoring: use combined z-score across p95 and error_rate; alert if score > 4 for 2 sliding windows
Dashboards: per-suggestion card showing predicted savings, actual savings streaming, and recent anomaly events
Pagerflow: auto-rollback events create a P1 incident in PagerDuty with links to config diff and recent traces
SLO guardrail logs: every routing decision during a staged apply is logged with reason (latency headroom, limiter state)
comments: 2026-03-11 - Aisha Kaur: Initial ticket created after sync with PM and SRE. We agreed to focus on cohort-level decisions rather than global changes to reduce blast radius.

2026-03-12 - Diego Ramos: Prototype candidate generator done. Early sims show 12-18% token cost reduction on long-tail routes with negligible p95 impact in synthetic runs. Pushed branch 'decision-service/proto' with basic API.

2026-03-13 - Emily Nguyen (SRE): Reviewed limiter integration. Suggested adding hysteresis to avoid rollbacks from transient spikes (recommend 2m cool-down). Also asked to include CPU tail as alternative signal for quota pressure.

2026-03-14 - Diego Ramos: Added short-window anomaly detector and wired auto-rollback executor. Current blocker: rollout engine requires a small API change to accept 'reason' metadata for automated actions (ticket sent to ENG-83655).
